content:
令 \(u=xt\)，则 \(t=\frac{u}{x}\)，\(\mathrm dt=\frac{1}{x}\mathrm du\)。当 \(x\to 0\) 且 \(x\neq 0\) 时，积分变为

\[
\int_{x^2}^{x}\frac{\sin(xt)}{t}\mathrm dt
=\int_{x^3}^{x^2}\frac{\sin u}{u}\mathrm du.
\]

因此原极限为

\[
L=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{1}{x^2}\int_{x^3}^{x^2}\frac{\sin u}{u}\mathrm du.
\]

由于

\[
\frac{\sin u}{u}=1+O(u^2)\quad (u\to 0),
\]

所以

\[
\int_{x^3}^{x^2}\frac{\sin u}{u}\mathrm du
=\int_{x^3}^{x^2}\bigl(1+O(u^2)\bigr)\mathrm du
=(x^2-x^3)+O(x^6).
\]

于是

\[
L=\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{x^2-x^3+O(x^6)}{x^2}
=\lim_{x\to 0}(1-x+O(x^4))=1.
\]

答案：B
